notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
I'm very excited to announce that the next update for Pirates Dragons will be the 1.0 release! This update includes the addition of the Ghost Ships as well as some balance tweaks and bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42266967/f8dd15f41ea1e9b68fafa2c098aee7a3fc84d95d.png[/img]

The update will go live at noon PDT on Friday.

After this update is launched I'm going to take some time to consider where to take Pirate Dragons next. There are still a couple of things I'd like to add/improve, but I'm very happy with where the game is now.

I've also decided to keep the price at $2.99 following the full launch.

Thank you to everyone who has supported Pirate Dragons!

-Jonathan Hanna
jon@supersixstudios.com

notes.title: Alpha 2.5 and Launch Update
notes.notes:
Today's update includes a big update to Wyvrens and some additional improvements based on feedback.
[list][*]Wyvrens are much more dangerous to ships now. Their fire breath can create more fires than before and additional fires based on the rank of the Captain of their ship.
[*]Ships can spawn multiple Wyvrens at a time now. The higher the crew rank, the higher chance to spawn more than one Wyvern, up to three.
[*]Wyverns are now more likely to target the player dragon.
[*]The player's dragon cannons can now hit Wyvrens.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42266967/fc232d6bbb6f01f8cdcea08b30755f8a7adf18ad.png[/img]

In addition to the updates for Wyvrens, this update also includes:
[list][*]It is now easier to find your location in the overworld map view.
[*]You can click on islands in the overworld map view to see what their produced resources are. These resources are more plentiful and cheaper at the town that produces them.
[*]Added a stinger to losing a battle.
[*]Fixed a bug with assigning ranks for crew, captain, hull, and cannons for newly created faction ships.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42266967/eca2fb34df9abe18bb73ad4507fe89150387dccc.png[/img]

Pirate Dragons is launching on August 11th and will be priced at $2.99. There will also be a small launch discount!

-Jonathan "Calandryll" Hanna

notes.title: Playtest Update - Build 0.03
notes.notes:
I just invited a while bunch of new players to the playtest and released a new update! 

Build 0.03 has been released into the playtest branch. This update includes:
[list][*]A big balance pass to gaining XP and gold from battles. This is a first pass and I expect to tweak things as we go. Note that gold and XP gain for other things like events, quests, etc have not been added yet. Just focusing on battles and the overall cost of buying things.
[list][*]Gold gain from winning battles.
[*]Loot from winning battles.
[*]Dragon XP for winning battles.
[*]Crew and Captain XP for winning battles.
[*]Costs for ships, ship upgrades, and captain and crew upgrades.
[*]Level XP requirements for dragon, crew, and captain.[/list]
[*]An update to the victory screen showing all of the above as well as faction changes.
[*]Events respawn over time - right now there are two events, more on the way!
[*]Added a compass in the overhead view.
[*]Added functionality for the rename captain button.
[*]Improved look of ocean when viewing ships in the Docks or Shipyard UI.
[*]Updated starting breath weapons. Fire is unlimited. Others are 1 use per battle. This can be increased through gaining levels and spending skill points.
[*]Updated all of the UI to use a slightly different look.
[*]Removed ship repairing. Not sure if I am going to re-add this or not.[/list]
Thank you to everyone already participating in the playtest and welcome to all of the new folks! Looking forward to hearing your feedback!

-Jonathan "Calandryll" Hanna

notes.title: Playtest Update
notes.notes:
I wanted to write a quick update on the Pirate Dragons playtest. First, thank you to everyone who has given my feedback.

I'm working on a few systems that I want to have in the game before starting the next playtest round. 
[list][*] Factions and Faction Reputation
[*] Quests/Missions
[*] Events[/list]
I'm hoping to have them all in and working next week. 

A quick synopsis of each feature.

There are 4 main [b]factions [/b]and 3 pirate factions in the world. You will have different reputation with each. A positive reputation will mean lower prices on repairs and upgrades and a low reputation will mean higher prices. A very low reputation may even result in that faction sending ships to attack you and/or refusing to give you quests or missions. Increasing your reputation with a faction will also unlock more quests and missions with that faction.

[b]Quests and Missions[/b] are usually given by the factions. Quests are one-offs and story driven, such as being asked to attack a specific pirate who has swindled a faction. Missions work pretty much the same as quests, but are repeatable and may include something like delivering goods from one town to another. Completing quests and missions will be one of the ways you can increase your reputation with a faction.

[b]Events [/b]can be found in the game, usually in the overworld view. These are multiple choice situations that can lead to treasure, faction notoriety changes, other rewards, and even ambushes. Below is an example of an event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42266967/537c2c3f232e26e89a91e9379dc44b285f028229.png[/img]
[i](art is placeholder)[/i]

Basically once these features are in, you'll be able to play a small sample of the game loop. The game will still feel grindy and it isn't balanced yet though. But anyone who wants to give feedback on the game will be able to play this build and have enough of an experience to get a sense of what the game will be. If I have time, I also want to hook up the save/load game system so you can progress without having to play for a long time all at once.

I'll be writing more information about these systems in the coming days. If you haven't signed up for the playtest yet now is a good time to do so! I will be inviting [b]everyone[/b] who signs up once the build is ready, hopefully in a week or two!

I'm very excited to be able to share Pirate Dragons with all of you and I'm looking forward to hear what you think of the game!

-Jonathan "Calandryll" Hanna
